paper_id: Liu et al. - 2020 - Indoor acoustic localization a survey
title: Indoor acoustic localization: a survey
venue: EURASIP Journal on Advances in Signal Processing
motivation: 现有GPS在室内失效,需高精度低延迟且通用设备即可实现的定位方案
